text:
Nora: dropping the compact canary preview mock — main two problems are focus visibility in dense rows and noisy SR announcements when scrubbing. figma.com/...

Cal: Repro'd. Focus ring is basically invisible at 2px; on keyboard open the detail drawer steals focus and doesn't restore to the scrubber. Also the tooltip flashes wildly when dragging.

Jin: For focus: use `outline: 3px solid var(--focus)` + `outline-offset: 2px` in compact mode. For drawer: save `document.activeElement` before open and restore on close.

Sam: SR noise: multiple attributes change during scrub (label + aria-pressed) — SR reads twice. Suggest a single `role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` announcer and update only innerText there. Debounce scrubs to 120ms to avoid queueing tooltip/show events.

a11y-bot: Scan: duplicate live regions and contrast failure for current focus style. Recommend single live region for dynamic updates and a focus style meeting 3:1 contrast for graphical focus.

Nora: UX nit: paused canaries look identical to disabled; users can't tell if preview is interactive. Idea: add a dashed border + small sr-only "preview paused" label and keep hover affordance active.

Cal: Copy tweak: tooltip should read "Canary: v2.5.0 — 10% — Fixes token expiry" not just the version. That helps context when arrowing.

Jin: I'll implement the announcer + debounce. Sam, can you mock the focus CSS and the dashed-pause affordance in the figma frame?

Sam: On it. I'll put both compact and expanded examples and include VoiceOver screenshots in the PR. Also proposing an undo toast after rollback (6s) with keyboard-focusable Undo button.

Nora: Sounds good. Priority: fix focus + SR for next patch, rollback toast in next sprint. Tagging eng-frontend for the focus restore behavior and eng-sre for CI regression checks. :white_check_mark:
